title: Xue Gao
description: Add more items to your game without altering the original items.
body:
# ⚠ Caution ⚠ This is an Xue Gai server resource pack. This resource pack requires the itemsadder server plugin to function. It is normal for it to be ineffective when used directly, as it is a server resource pack.

## Xue Gao is a resource pack currently under development. It provides alternative textures for items without altering Minecraft's default appearance. The goal is to incorporate more items into the pack.
This resource pack utilizes a feature of itemsadder—custom block models—to add new models.Without this feature, it will not function properly!

<details>
<summary>Add Item List</summary>

**Right Couplet**
